result.title: CUA-Recovery: Benchmarking Error Recovery in Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents
result.summary: As computer-use agents (CUAs) move to long-horizon workflows spanning multiple applications, undetected errors can silently corrupt persistent state and cause cascading failures in subsequent actions. Reliable error detection and recovery have become critical bottlenecks for building robust CUAs. However, existing benchmarks focus primarily on end-to-end task performance, providing limited insight into whether agents can detect and recover from errors during execution. The few benchmarks that evaluate recovery rely largely on manually injected errors, which may not reflect the types or horizons of failures induced by real agent policies. We introduce CUA-Recovery, a benchmark comprising test and training suites across multiple desktop applications. We construct it using ReRail, a framework for synthesizing long-horizon tasks and trajectories in a persistent desktop environment. ReRail composes MyPCBench tasks into new long-horizon workflows with executable ground truth, collects verifier-confirmed failures from multiple policies, and turns them into verified recovery trajectories. CUA-Recovery comprises a human-verified test suite of 2,250 erroneous states over 100 tasks and a training suite of 8.6K trajectories over 377 tasks. Evaluation on the test suite shows that agents struggle both to recognize inherited errors and to complete the task. Across six agents and six takeover depths, Error Awareness Rate (EAR) reaches at most 44.0% and Pass@3 at most 25.5%. After fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on the training suite, its average EAR rises from 19.9% to 35.2% on held-out recovery states, and its Rubric Score goes from 5.0% to 16.1%. It also gains 15.3 points on MyPCBench and 10.8 points on Odysseys for Pass@3, showing that the training trajectories help both with recovery and with completing tasks from a clean start. Our code is available at https://github.com/xu-hu-2002/CUA-Recovery.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CUA-Recovery 基准：用 ReRail 框架把桌面任务组合成长程工作流，从多个策略中收集经校验的失败并转成恢复轨迹，构建 2250 个错误状态测试集与 8.6K 训练轨迹，评估六个 agent 的错误感知与恢复，并用训练集微调 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「错误感知率」与多档接管深度考察 agent 能否从视觉状态判断已继承的错误并决定干预或终止，可能与 LVR 的停止决策、证据核查及恢复式轨迹监督形成概念类比，可供核查；但材料未涉及 latent 表示层面的分析。
